name: Thick diving gloves
description: Five-finger neoprene gloves thick enough for cold water, with long gauntlet cuffs and a strap that cinches each wrist shut. Clumsy for fine work.
notes: Lying flat as a pair, backs up, 352 mm across the pair and 264 mm long: thick gloves with flared gauntlet cuffs bound in grey, a darker grip patch over the knuckles and a black wrist strap with a grey hook-and-loop tab. CHECK VOLUME (x5.2): laid flat, the pair spans a wider box than the reference packs it into. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wetsuit hood
description: A snug neoprene hood that closes round the face and keeps cold water off the head and neck.
notes: Standing upright as on a shelf, 224 mm across and 308 mm tall: a snug turned hood with a grey-bound face opening on +z, a grey flatlock seam up the back and a short neck collar. CHECK VOLUME (x15): the model stands hollow round a head-sized space, while the reference counts the hood bunched up. Slot `hood`: it is worn under a helmet or mask strap, which takes `head`. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Thick wetsuit hood
description: A thick neoprene hood for cold water, with a wide bib that tucks under a suit collar to seal out the chill.
notes: Standing upright, 312 mm tall: the snug hood with a short neck flare and its bib slumped on the floor in a long front flap and a shorter back flap, 416 mm from front to back, a blue-bound face opening, grey flatlock seams up the back and round the neck, and a small vent valve on the crown that sets it apart from the thin hood. CHECK VOLUME (x33): the model stands hollow over its bib flaps, while the reference counts the hood bunched up. Slot `hood`, as the thin hood. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wetsuit jacket

The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wetsuit pants

The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Technical wetsuit shorts
description: Neoprene shorts with a big flapped pocket on each thigh. They can be worn alone or pulled snug over a wetsuit.
notes: Folded in three layers, 280 mm by 240 mm and 56 mm tall: a grey drawcord waist and a bellows pocket on each side under a grey flap, each with a steel press stud and a drain eyelet. Pockets in `nylon-black` over the neoprene. Pockets are a judgement: each thigh pocket holds a small flat item. The loose state shares this model. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Technical wetsuit shorts (loose)
description: The same pocketed neoprene shorts let out at the waist so they pull on over a wetsuit.
notes: Rides on `wetsuit_shorts_technical`: the loose fit is a waist adjustment that does not show when folded. Folded in three layers, 280 mm by 240 mm and 56 mm tall. In Deadvox the tight and loose states would better be one item with a toggle; that needs a wearable-state mechanism, so it stays a separate draft. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Spring suit
description: A long-sleeved neoprene wetsuit cut off above the knee, with pink side panels and a zip across the chest. Lighter and freer than a full suit.
notes: Laid flat, front up, neck towards -z, 1240 mm across the sleeves and 960 mm from collar to leg hem: long sleeves, short legs, a black zip across the chest, and pink side panels, collar and flatlock seams. Slot `torso`, as whole-body suits take; it should also block `legs` (the legs to the knee). The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
